Hi Karthik,

Hope youre doing well — OpenStitch is running a community DevWeek (Sept 18-21) focused on maintainers and infra toolchains. Were coordinating with a handful of open-source maintainers who will be running live workshops and small sprints.

Wed love to feature Redwood Inference as an infra sponsor (credits + short trial extension for maintainers). Typical ask: 100k tokens per maintainer (approx 3-5 maintainers), trial extension of 60 days for workshop participants, and a short co-branded landing page.

Attached is our short application and schedule. Participant profile: experienced OSS maintainers (CI, model infra, runtimes) and 400+ attendees across workshops. Expected usage pattern: bursts during workshops + follow-up evaluation in next 2 months.

Could you let me know if this is something Redwood can support and what a recommended credit allocation would look like? Happy to hop on a 20-min call this week.

Stef / Laura — forwarding an application from OpenStitch for DevWeek sponsorship. Key asks: token credits for ~3-5 maintainers (100k tokens ea, bursts) + 60-day trial extension for participants and a co-branded landing mention.

Why Im recommending support:
- High-signal audience (maintainers & infra engineers) aligned with our outreach goals for model serving adoption.
- Likely to produce post-event adoption pilots (we can track via unique project codes).
- Low dollar exposure if we use trial extension + token credit model; proposal attached shows cost estimate.

Proposal I drafted: 3 maintainer grants at 120k tokens each (360k total) + 90-day trial extension for all workshop attendees, tracked via promo code. Rationale: slightly higher token buffer to account for live demos and follow-ups.

Attachment: credits_proposal.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Can you weigh in on approval and any governance/marketing requirements? If approved, Ill produce a short SOW and get it routed to Partnerships for tracking.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Partnerships (on Growth)
Redwood Inference

Thanks for the context, Karthik. Im supportive of participating but recommend the following guardrails before we commit: 

1) Cap credits to 100k tokens per maintainer (3 maintainers max) — to keep spend predictable.
2) Require explicit social/technical callouts (tweet + blog blurb) and a short workshop slide acknowledging Redwood.
3) Use a dedicated promo code and HubSpot deal (please create HS-45291) for tracking engagement and any future conversion.
4) Ask legal for a one-paragraph acceptance of our standard sponsorship language (Ill loop them if we move forward).

If those hold, I approve. Also prefer the 60-day trial extension instead of 90 to keep exposure lower.

Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Growth Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment referenced: none
